paragraphs.text: Mikkel was a village in the hinterlands of Kjeldor , on the continent of Terisiare at the time of the Dominarian Ice Age .

Mikkel was where Kaysa grew up before she became the Elder Druid , and was the parish at which Halvor Arenson was the priest. In 2934 AR , the lowest parts of the Kjeldoran capital of Krov were awash with refugees, mostly from the farmsteads and towns beyond Mikkel. The same year, the village fell to Lim-Dûl 's legions under the charge of the traitor Avram Garrisson , but through ten-year-old Kaysa's and Kolbjörn 's magics and the valiant efforts of Disa , Lucilde Fiksdotter and Klazina Jansdotter , the dead were laid to rest. After burying the dead, the six survivors abandoned the village and headed south toward Fyndhorn .
